messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Added **Deal name** under **Reproduce a game**. Names now return when you load saved progress.

Fixed pasted saves failing when JSON fields appear in a different order. Existing saves and replays remain compatible.

Build, type checks, 148 unit checks, and all 81 browser journeys pass. Changed files pass formatting; the repository-wide check still reports 23 pre-existing issues.
